tagline: Builder of brands, champion of women’s sport, dad on the move
summary: When the lights are off, Alexis is a hands‑on dad who loves snapping photos with his daughter in far‑off cities. He spends his days turning ideas—like a retail hub on Lafayette Street—into physical spaces while pushing equity in track & field. Behind the hustle he’s quietly driven by the belief that progress in women’s sport is a legacy worth leaving for his kids.
